NWS Detroit/Pontiac · 723 PM EDT Sat Oct 31 2026

- Mild and mostly cloudy through early next week.

- Warmer on Tuesday with an increasing chance of rain mid-week.

&&

.AVIATION...

Persistent ridging over the Great Lakes has started to break down 
this evening as warm advection takes precedence. This has led to a 
blanket of mid-cloud (centered around 10.0 kft agl) while moisture 
lifts along the frontal slope. This has also generated very light 
shower activity across the southern portions of the airspace. SE 
Michigan will remain in a transition period through Sunday, 
maintaining the 10.0 kft cloud deck and light east-southeast flow.
